title: PoP deleted
description: An operator deleted a PoP relay and, with it, its party wall (R74, docs/76). The event names the PoP and nothing else about it: never an address, a pairing string or a credential. The `data` of a `fi.ioio.gawk.pop.deleted` CloudEvent.

pop.description: The PoP the operator acted on: the Pop resource's name.

displayName.description: The PoP's name as shown to people, as it was before the deletion.
